Description:
Experience luxury redefined in this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home on the 24th floor of The Butterfly—an architectural icon by Revery Architecture, with breathtaking ocean and city views.

The home features a sleek, modern interior with top-of-the-line finishes, including a high-end kitchen equipped with Miele appliances, custom cabinetry, and quartz countertops. The open-concept layout is enhanced by elegant engineered hardwood flooring and a contemporary bathroom designed for comfort and style.

Residents of The Butterfly enjoy access to an exceptional range of amenities, including a 24-hour concierge, swimming pool, fully equipped fitness centre, wellness centre with hydrotherapy, a tranquil music room with a grand piano, and beautifully designed lounge and social spaces.
